spec: ES module exporting `parseDuration(str)`: parses a compact duration string such as "1h30m" and returns the total number of seconds as an integer. Units: d (86400 s), h (3600 s), m (60 s), s (1 s). Each part is a non-negative integer immediately followed by its unit letter, with no spaces.
properties: a single part returns its value times the unit's seconds ("2h" is 7200, "45s" is 45)
parts must appear in the order d, h, m, s; any other order throws a TypeError
a unit may appear at most once; a repeated unit throws a TypeError
anything else (empty string, unknown unit, number without unit, spaces, non-string input) throws a TypeError
